description: §6.7.1a — the VARIANT-BIND block arm `| ::Boom e -> { … }` of an `!{}` inside an `on mount { }` body (matches a named error variant and binds `e`; behaviorally distinct from both the wildcard `| _ e -> { … }` and the `:>` recovery forms). `let r = risky() !{ | ::Boom e -> { @status = "caught-var" } }` — pre-fix bc51b610 fails E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC; post-fix the arm's block runs at mount. No input — the boot/mount shape.
rationale: §6.7.1a sugar-equivalence — a `!{}` variant-bind block arm inside `on mount` lowers exactly as inside a `function` body. risky() fails with LoadError.Boom; the `| ::Boom e -> { … }` arm matches that variant and runs its block, setting @status = "caught-var".
